assertions.text: Output has exactly one line per input bullet (6 lines) in the form '- [<TYPE>] <Summary> (#<id>)'
Types are mapped correctly: feature to FEAT, bug to FIX, docs to DOCS, refactor to CHORE
Lines are grouped in the order FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE
Input order is kept inside each group (#12 before #13, #15 before #16)
Summaries are sentence case, have no trailing period, and are at most 60 characters
